text:
olivia chen: Quick note — onboarding feedback: the Dedicated autoscale section is too wordy. users want a one-click copy snippet and a tiny migration map for v1->v2 field changes. can someone add a "quickcopy" box?
diego ramos: yup. happy to add. thinking: one-line summary, 8-line YAML, 4-line python SDK, and a 2-line terraform inline example. small migration map below.
kevin z.: also call out "operational gotchas": min_replicas=0 => cold starts; burst_enabled without reserved pool => not SLA-backed. put those as two bullets under snippets.
olivia chen: perfect. also please align YAML field names with SDK names (we swapped `qps_target` -> `target_qps_per_replica` last quarter and folks missed it).
diego ramos: draft here, kept minimal and copy-ready. please sanity-check and I can open PR.
```yaml
# copy-paste minimal autoscale policy
name: web-front-lowlat
min_replicas: 1
max_replicas: 8
burst_enabled: true
target_qps_per_replica: 90
preemption_policy: standard
```
(one-line: minimal policy for low-latency frontends)
```python
# python sdk minimal
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
pol = c.create_autoscale_policy(name="web-front-lowlat", min_replicas=1, max_replicas=8, burst_enabled=True, target_qps_per_replica=90)
print(pol.id)
```
(one-line: equivalent SDK call)
```hcl
# terraform inline (2-line)
resource "redwood_autoscale_policy" "web" { name = "web-front-lowlat" min_replicas = 1 }
```
Migration map (v1 -> v2):
- qps_target -> target_qps_per_replica
- priority -> preemption_policy
- enable_burst -> burst_enabled

kevin z.: nit: change "preemption_policy: standard" -> "preemption_policy: notify" in example? i worry people will assume preemption is aggressive. maybe keep "standard" but add a note.
diego ramos: good call. I'll add a short sentence under the snippet: "preemption_policy controls tenant eviction behavior; default 'standard' is moderate."
kevin z.: add the two operational bullets as requested by olivia.
diego ramos: done and kept them terse:
- operational: min_replicas=0 => cold start latency on first requests
- SLA note: burst capacity only SLA-backed when using reserved pools (see provisioning glossary)

docs-bot: Reminder: include "Examples" checkbox in PR template and add docs-tests sample under examples/fixtures.
olivia chen: thanks — can you open the PR and tag me? I will do a quick pass and merge if small.
diego ramos: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4233 - contains the snippets + migration map + link to infra terraform examples. CI linting passed locally.
kevin z.: reviewing now. small wording nit re: glossary link.
diego ramos: addressed the nit, pushed commit. ready for final review.
olivia chen: will review in the next hour and merge if clean. thanks team!
